This file provides guidance to Claude Code (claude.ai/code) when working with code in this repository. Modern, enterprise-grade dotfiles repo; supports macOS/Linux/WSL; tier-based config for shell/tmux/Neovim; progressive complexity; performance optimization; comprehensive dev tools.

Commands/procedures (verbatim):
./install.sh install standard
./install.sh install minimal     # Essential tools only
./install.sh install full        # Complete setup with AI tools
./install.sh install ai_focused  # AI-enhanced development
./install.sh --dry-run install standard
./install.sh link
dot setup              # Idempotent environment setup
dot check              # Comprehensive health validation
dot update             # Update all components
dot reload             # Reload shell configuration
dot project init       # Create new project
dot ai review          # AI code review
dot security scan      # Security audit
dot metrics dashboard  # View system metrics
dot plugin list        # Manage plugins
dot migrate status     # Check for updates
./tests/test_runner.sh
dot test quick
./tests/test_runner.sh --category infrastructure
find . -name "*.sh" -exec shellcheck {} \;
find . -name "*.yaml" -o -name "*.yml" | xargs yamllint
dot check                    # Full system health check
dot doctor                   # Diagnose issues
dot test run                 # Run all tests
perf-status                  # Check performance
perf-bench                   # Run benchmarks
perf-quick                   # One-command optimization

Key layout:
bin/ (DOT CLI); config/ (templates/core configs); lib/ (core libs by functionality); plugins/ (plugin system); scripts/ (install/util); tests/ (testing framework).
Main interface: dot in bin/dot; orchestrates via lib/cli/: core.sh, ai.sh, security.sh, project.sh, testing.sh.
Declarative: config/tools.yaml.
Profiles: minimal, standard, full, ai_focused.
Platform detection: automatic OS/distro with package managers.
Tier 1: 8 essential plugins; Tier 2: 23 plugins; Tier 3: 33+ plugins.
Plugins: plugins/core/, plugins/community/, plugins/local/ (local user customizations); template: plugins/local/hello-world/.
Nvim: config/nvim/init.lua; core in config/nvim/lua/core/; tiers in config/nvim/lua/tiers/; languages in config/nvim/lua/languages/.
Tmux: config/tmux/tmux.conf + config/tmux/core.conf; essential bindings: Ctrl-a prefix, hjkl navigation, | and - for splits.
Zsh: config/zsh/ modular; perf modes fast (<300ms), balanced (<500ms), full (<1000ms); auto-detect system resources; enhanced autosuggestions/history.
